title: Try a clock, inspect it, and keep your changes
summary: Open your local Handbook, check and run a clock, inspect its resident Patchbay, edit its timing, then lull and recover the same Body.

steps.title: Open your own Handbook
steps.action: Open the static Handbook in a fresh browser profile.
steps.observation: The Handbook creates a local Body, then wakes its resident application. The page offers lessons, editable source, and lifecycle controls.

steps.title: Check an unfinished edit
steps.action: Open Start here, choose the clock lesson, enter unfinished source, and press Try in my Handbook.
steps.observation: Live highlighting follows the Unicode edit. The checker reports a refusal; the existing Body, Play, and installed workset remain unchanged.

steps.title: Run the clock lesson
steps.action: Restore the clock source and press Try in my Handbook.
steps.observation: The checked clock joins the same Body and runs through a newly admitted Plan and Play.

steps.title: Inspect the running clock
steps.action: Press Open in Patchbay, choose the clock, focus its output port, and press Enter.
steps.observation: The resident Patchbay shows the clock's gears, ports, and cord. Its selected output port and graph identities belong to this Body's actual Plan and Play.

steps.title: Change the clock's timing
steps.action: Change time/every(1s) to time/every(2s), then press Try in my Handbook.
steps.observation: The same Body replaces the clock with the newly checked source and admits a new Plan and Play. The workset does not grow with a duplicate clock.

steps.title: Bring the Body to rest
steps.action: After checking that the edit survives switching lessons and inspecting the new graph, press Lull.
steps.observation: Execution ends and Wake becomes available. The Body retains the edited clock without an active Play.

steps.title: Return to your edited clock
steps.action: Press Wake, then reload the page.
steps.observation: The same Host and Body return with a fresh Boot, Plan, and Play. The two-second source, installed workset, and foreground selection survive.
